dct_description_sm: This point shapefile shows the locations of built up areas (areas containing a concentration of buildings and other structures) in Cote d'Ivoire. The Global Map Cote d'Ivoire version 2 was developed based on Global Map Specifications version 2.2. The data source of Boundary, Drainage and Transportation layers were a 1:500000 map image (Topo 500 V2) made in 2012.
Global Map data were developed under the cooperation of National Geospatial Information Authorities (NGIAs) of respective countries and regions.
